name: nexus-coders-brand-audit
description: Multi-skill Agent Skill Marketplace for automated website brand auditing — evaluating off-site AI discoverability, cross-web corroboration/freshness, and on-site visitor engagement to produce prioritized, mechanism-sound fixes and proactive improvements.
author: Nexus Coders

skills.description: The designated entrypoint skill that coordinates specialized sub-skills (crawl-render-audit, freshness-corroboration, engagement-audit), synthesizes cross-skill correlations, and emits the final unified JSON audit report.

Dedicated skill for off-site AI discoverability: robots.txt AI crawler access, XML sitemap verification, llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, JS-render gaps, and non-text media trapping (images/canvas/PDF).
Dedicated skill for cross-web entity corroboration, brand naming collision/ambiguity detection via knowledge graph search, and temporal freshness signals.

Dedicated skill running an independent, robots.txt-respecting crawl for on-site retention: above-the-fold value proposition clarity, landing orientation, information density, CTA friction, and layout-shift risk.
